title: Polly gets a sturdier search index
summary:
Polly’s search got more resilient, two community apps joined the catalog, and the README caught up with recent changes.

Two PRs from Itachi-1824 improved Polly’s code and documentation search: smaller, token-aware embedding batches avoid input limits, documentation indexing handles markdown and missing titles, and both indexes check for updates on restart. Polly also skips unrelated Discord messages before doing reply checks or API work.

The catalog added ppo, a Pollinations-powered chat assistant by @AnesNT-DZ, and BrainrotMaker, an image generator by @lualearnings. Both were added to the README showcase, and the App Greenhouse listing was refreshed.

The README’s Latest News was updated to cover GENEXUS AI developer tools, the SDK and MCP package move, and `seedance` duration support. Older entries made way for the update; this PR changed the news, not those features.
